remarks: Bright & Spacious 1-Bedroom Condo in the Heart of Springdale! Discover easy living in this bright, airy, and well-maintained 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo perfectly located in the lively Springdale neighborhood-just a short distance from the Springdale Train Station! The open-concept living and dining area features sliders to a private balcony, ideal for morning coffee or evening relaxation. The kitchen offers ample cabinet space and a convenient breakfast bar for casual dining. The generous bedroom includes a double closet and direct balcony access. An in-unit laundry room provides extra storage and everyday convenience. Enjoy a vibrant lifestyle with restaurants, shopping, and entertainment just minutes away, plus quick access to the train, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway. A perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and location!
